description.value: Howard Johnson by Wyndham Victoria is a three-storey chain hotel on Gorge Road East, part of the Wyndham Hotels & Resorts portfolio. Located in Victoria, BC, it serves as a familiar mid-range overnight option for touring cyclists arriving on Vancouver Island. The property is within the city and provides standard hotel room accommodation as a base for exploring Victoria and connecting to regional cycling routes.
